content_summary: Festival Eurazania: Week of Strength starts in 30 days and lasts 7 days; visitors free.
Strong emphasis on attracting Blumund adventurers.
Tournament includes mass qualification, difficult terrain, group trial against cohesive experienced Eurazania beast-army units with individual assessment, then individual fights.
Same published rules for locals and foreigners; outsiders can inspect relevant terrain.

Monetary prizes planned for top participants including top 10, exact amounts not yet set; winner also receives separate Crown reward form TBD and official right to challenge King Carrion, who must accept.
Bout with Carrion is real, not staged or execution.
Arlequino will perform full canonical song 'Герои' immediately before Carrion-vs-winner and promises to write a new separate song about the eventual winner after the tournament.
Rena asks Lissa to spread news through Blumund contacts, especially adventurers, traders, performers and travelers.
